heading: FAQ
subtext: Got questions? We've gathered the most common answers to help you understand how we work.

faqs.question: Do you work on residential or commercial projects?
faqs.answer: We work across residential and select commercial interiors, creating spaces that feel personal and considered.

faqs.question: What types of projects do you take on?
faqs.answer: From single-room transformations to full-scale interiors, we tailor our approach to each project.

faqs.question: What if my style doesn't match yours?
faqs.answer: Our process starts with you, not a signature style. We shape each project around your taste, not the other way around.

faqs.question: Can you work with my existing furniture?
faqs.answer: Absolutely. We love combining meaningful existing pieces with new elements.

faqs.question: How involved will I be in the process?
faqs.answer: Your input guides the project while we handle the creative direction and details.

faqs.question: How long does a project take?
faqs.answer: Timelines vary by scope, but we'll establish a clear schedule before the project begins.

faqs.question: What happens after I enquire?
faqs.answer: We'll review your project, get to know your vision, and arrange an initial conversation.
